reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: claimTokenAllocation is a public external function with non-test callers in LegionPreLiquidApprovedSale.sol and interfaces. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; the attack entry point is an untrusted external investor. Gate 3: the finding is a missing protocol-state precondition check (whenTokensSupplied absent from claimTokenAllocation at L251-313), not an MEV-only issue or capital-withdrawal issue. Code at L739 confirms hasSettled=true permanently blocks future claims. An attacker can trigger this via the claimTokenAllocation external entry point by depositing the exact investor allocation amount of askToken into the contract after publishSaleResults sets the Merkle root but before supplyTokens is called, causing the investor's hasSettled flag to be set to true with the attacker-provided balance, permanently locking the investor out of their official token allocation when it is subsequently deposited. Severity maintained at High: high impact (permanent investor lock-out) with medium likelihood (requires targeted griefing setup with known allocation amount).
